examples.title: Pick the reference distribution
examples.source: Exam 1 Questions 3 and 4, Homework 2 Problems 1(b) and 2(a)
examples.prompt: Name the reference distribution for each statistic. (a) Exam 1 Question 3, the mean BUN of 16 healthy adults compared with the cutoff 15 mg/100mL, when the population mean is \(\mu = 18\) mg/100mL and the population SD is \(\sigma = 6\) mg/100mL. (b) Homework 2 Problem 1(b), the mean LDL of 16 undergraduates, \(\bar x = 103\) mg/dL, compared with 115 mg/dL, with \(s = 16\) mg/dL found from the sample. (c) Exam 1 Question 4, the ANOVA ratio for three groups of 12. (d) Homework 2 Problem 2(a), the difference in the proportion of female babies for 186 and 220 births.

steps.say: In (a) the population SD of 6 is given, so the standardized mean follows Z. In (b) the SD of 16 comes from the sample, so it does not follow Z.
In (b) the SD is estimated from 16 students, so the statistic follows t with 15 degrees of freedom.
In (c) F divides one variance estimate by another, so it follows F with 2 and 33 degrees of freedom.
In (d) the samples are large, so the z statistic for two proportions is compared with the infinity row of the t table. That row is the Normal distribution.
